notes.kkumi-na-emu: “Eleven” ne “twelve” tebigoberera nkola. Okuva ku “thirteen” okutuuka ku “nineteen”, enamba zikoma ku -teen.
notes.abiri: Twenty, thirty, fifty: amakumi gakoma ku -ty. Weegendereze “fifteen” ne “fifty”.

guidebook.intro: Bala okutuuka ku nkumi mu Lungereza, era osasule mu siringi. Enamba z’Olungereza zirina enkola enyangu bw’omala okuzimanya.

tips.title: -teen ne -ty
body: Okuva ku 13 okutuuka ku 19 enamba zikoma ku **-teen**: **thirteen**, **fifteen**, **nineteen**. Amakumi gakoma ku **-ty**: **twenty**, **thirty**, **fifty**.
Weegendereze: **fifteen** (15) ne **fifty** (50) biwulikika kumpi kye kimu. Mu **fifteen**, doboozi lisinga ku nkomerero.

culture.title: Sente mu Lungereza
body: Mu Uganda abantu batera okugamba **five thousand** oba **five K** ku siringi 5,000. Mu baasi ne ku bodaboda, buuza **How much is it?** nga tonalinya.
